items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair incl. thermal-imaging leak detection (flat rate)
items.rationale: Frost fracture of an internal fitting is covered under 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9 (fitting, labour, consumables, one attendance), and leak location with thermal imaging is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 (cap EUR 2,500). The lump sum prices covered work only (7.1.12), so I estimate a fair ordinary price for the fitting renewal plus the thermal survey.

items.description: Exterior facade frost damage repair, re-plaster and repaint (flat rate)
items.rationale: The facade damage was caused by outdoor cold acting on the external surface, which is the optional frost peril 2.1(d). It is not shown as agreed, so 3.5 and 2.6.4 exclude it, together with all the plaster, paint and ancillary work. It does not come from the internal escape of water, so 2.4.3 does not apply, and the combined line falls as a whole under 7.1.13, so t = 0.
